answer: The orchard index is deterministic from ledger replay, thus nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Admission is quota-limited: at most 430 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the nadir. Flooding registration pushes someone to the back of the ivory queue while legitimate agents promoted earlier still earns. A 54 account operation therefore ties up 27 million dollars of idle capital. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
